pr_title: Bluetooth: Mesh: Drop support for Bluetooth Mesh 1.0.1
pr_body:
This PR drops support of Bluetooth Mesh Profile 1.0.1 and makes the Zephyr stack support Bluetooth Mesh Protocol 1.1. The explicit support for both versions requires additional maintenance efforts and doubles the CI time. Mesh 1.1 is backward compatible with Mesh 1.0.1, therefore the stack can still be qualified for 1.0.1 if needed. But if one wants to do this, they need to compile out the private beacons reception.

What is changed:
- Removed `CONFIG_BT_MESH_V1d1` option.
- 1.1 Kconfig options are sorted out by the submenus they belong to.
- Removed `transport_legacy.c` which was using 1.0.1 implementation. The new transport layer has new SaR logic that should still be possible to qualify for 1.0.1.
- Removed the legacy transport Kconfig options. They are superseded by the new transport Kconfig options.
- Tester app: `overlay-mesh-v1d1.conf` is merged into `overlay-mesh.conf`.
- Removed BabbleSim tests for 1.0.1.
- Updated documentation.

Fixes #65985

issue_context.title: RFC: API Change: Bluetooth: Mesh: Remove the CONFIG_BT_MESH_V1d1 and the legacy transport Kconfig options
issue_context.body:
## Introduction

Remove the [CONFIG_BT_MESH_V1d1](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/c94cd30cecbf8247e1f1c776d065a07b59b0fc25/subsys/bluetooth/mesh/Kconfig#L1051-L1055) Kconfig option and the legacy transport [Kconfig options](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/c94cd30cecbf8247e1f1c776d065a07b59b0fc25/subsys/bluetooth/mesh/Kconfig#L508-L552) and make Zephyr Bluetooth Mesh stack 1.1 compatible.

### Problem description

Currently, the Bluetooth Mesh Profile 1.0.1 is supported by the Zephyr Bluetooth Mesh implementation by default and the Bluetooth Mesh Protocol 1.1 and the corresponding features are enabled through `CONFIG_BT_MESH_V1d1` Kconfig option. However, we want to drop the support of Bluetooth Mesh Profile 1.0.1 and replace it with the Bluetooth Mesh Protocol 1.1. The explicit support of both versions requires additional maintenance efforts and doubles the CI time (if tests are not parallelized). The 1.1 version is backward compatible with the 1.0.1, if one needs, they can still qualify the stack for 1.0.1. But in this case they need to remove private beacon reception. This also means that we need to drop support for the legacy transport Kconfig options. Following the [regular deprecation procedure](https://docs.zephyrproject.org/latest/develop/api/api_lifecycle.html#deprecated) will make us spend effort on maintaining these Kconfigs and the legacy transport layer for 2 more releases.

### Proposed change

- Remove the `CONFIG_BT_MESH_V1d1` Kconfig option.
- Remove the legacy transport [Kconfig options](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/c94cd30cecbf8247e1f1c776d065a07b59b0fc25/subsys/bluetooth/mesh/Kconfig#L508-L552).
    - They are superseded by the [new Kconfig options](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/c94cd30cecbf8247e1f1c776d065a07b59b0fc25/subsys/bluetooth/mesh/Kconfig#L1513-L1631).

PR #65984 implements the proposed changes.

## Detailed RFC

In addition to Kconfigs, this change will affect:
- BabbleSim tests for 1.0.1 will be removed.
- Tester app will use 1.1 features by default. AutoPTS will still run 1.0.1 qualification tests until it is requested to run 1.1 qualification tests.
- Samples will run with mesh 1.1.

### Dependencies

The users of the stack will have to replace the legacy transport Kconfig options with the new options.

### Concerns and Unresolved Questions

Those who want to use 1.0.1 and keep their qualification, should remove the private beacons reception and disable SHA256 algorithm in the provisioning (`CONFIG_BT_MESH_ECDH_P256_HMAC_SHA256_AES_CCM`).

## Alternatives

- Keep Kconfigs as is (1.1 support and the legacy transport with its Kconfig options) forever and spend efforts on maintaining them.
- Drop the legacy transport, but keep 1.1 support toggleable.
- Mark `CONFIG_BT_MESH_V1d1` and the legacy transport Kconfig options as `DEPRECATED` and follow the [regular deprecation procedure](https://docs.zephyrproject.org/latest/develop/api/api_lifecycle.html#deprecated) for 2 more releases.
comments: I've added this on today's Arch WG meeting as per our guidelines. If someone wishes to present the issue there, that'll be great. If not, I'll just mention it for added visibility.

- RFC to be further discussed on the upcoming Bluetooth WG meeting.

review_comments: Now in theory, it looks like Mesh 1.0 node will be able to receive and decrypt private beacon, this seems at odds with the commit message? May be for that reason we may need BT_MESH_V101. Alternatively, we could also wrap this up behind SHA256 algorithm option, which seems like a proxy for Mesh 1.1 support?
Good point. Using SHA256 option to enable mesh-1.1 won't be that intuitive. So perhaps we should leave 1.1 option and only remove legacy transport?

Didn't it remove support for v1.0.1 in general? It claims backward compatibility with v1.0.1 but it is not v1.0.1 anymore.
After removing this option it is not possible to build mesh v1.0.1. It is possible to build 1.1 that passes PTS 1.0.1 tests.

I agree with Alex, the idea is that "Mesh 1.0 node" is not something you can compile after this PR goes in. Only "Mesh 1.1 node". Which according to spec is backward compatible so it can be dropped into any network and pass qualification.

Discussed offline: I'll rephrase the PR description and comment to clearly state that this PR makes the stack in Zephyr mesh 1.1 compatible, not mesh 1.0.1. To make it back mesh 1.0.1 compatible, the private beacons reception and SHA256 algorithm should be compiled out.
